title: Companies Act, 2013 — private-company meeting exemptions under section 462

content.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
content.citation: Notification G.S.R. 464(E), 5 June 2015, read with G.S.R. 583(E), 13 June 2017, and corrigendum S.O. 2218(E), 13 July 2017
content.verificationStatus: IndiaCode-hosted Gazette PDF copies of G.S.R. 464(E) (5 June 2015), G.S.R. 583(E) (13 June 2017), and corrigendum S.O. 2218(E) (13 July 2017) retrieved and operative clauses checked. Direct MCA-hosted copies and the subsequent/current notification position have not been independently verified.
content.note: Primary-instrument scope check: the IndiaCode-hosted Gazette PDF copy of G.S.R. 464(E), 5 June 2015, was inspected and its Chapter VII row lists sections 101–107 and section 109, applying unless otherwise specified in the respective section or the company’s articles provide otherwise. The IndiaCode-hosted Gazette PDF copy of G.S.R. 583(E), 13 June 2017, was also inspected; paragraph 7 inserts paragraph 2A limiting the table’s exceptions, modifications and adaptations to private companies that have not defaulted in filing financial statements under section 137 or annual returns under section 92. The IndiaCode-hosted Gazette PDF copy of corrigendum S.O. 2218(E), 13 July 2017, was retrieved and inspected: it replaces “statement or” with “statement and” in paragraph 5, table item (ii), of G.S.R. 583(E). On the operative text inspected, that correction concerns the section 143(3)(i) auditor-reporting exemption and does not alter the section 101–107/109 table entry or paragraph 2A filing-default eligibility condition. The IndiaCode page states that the Department’s own PDF remains authoritative; direct MCA-hosted PDFs and later/current notification position remain unverified. Verify company filing eligibility and articles before applying any modification. This scoped source review is not final legal sign-off.
